newsitem.title: USA: Sundstrand sees $2.25-$2.40 EPS for FY96.
newsitem.headline: Sundstrand sees $2.25-$2.40 EPS for FY96.

text.p: Sundstrand Corp said Friday it continues to expect earnings for 1996 of between $2.25 and $2.40 a share, excluding restructuring costs and any additional share repurchases.
Earlier, Sundstrand reported third quarter earnings of $0.57 a share after $0.02 a share in restructuring expenses, compared with year-ago earnings of $0.53 a share.
Sales for the quarter were $371 million, up from $349 million from ongoing businesses a year ago. Total year-ago sales were $355 million.
Sundstrand said it repurchased 189,000 shares during the third quarter, for a total of 1,011,000 in 1996. The company said it plans to continue to repurchase shares.

The company said third quarter sales in the aerospace segment were up $16.0 million, or nine percent, compared with the third quarter of 1995. Operating profit increased by $8.0 million or 26 percent. Total aerospace orders increased by 28 percent in the third quarter compared with a year ago.

"The improving commercial aerospace cycle continues to drive our aerospace segment," Robert Jenkins, Sundstrand president, said in a statement. "We continue to project total aerospace sales to increase between five percent and 10 percent from 1995."

Sundstrand said industrial segment sales in the third quarter increased by $6.0 million or four percent compared with a year ago. Operating profit, however, fell by $2.0 million or seven percent from the 1995 third quarter due to continued market and margin weakness in Sullair's European business.
Total industrial orders rose by two percent in the third quarter compared with a year ago.
"We expect industrial sales to increase about two percent for 1996, with operating profit margins of around 16 percent," Jenkins said.
